faqs.a: Orders ship within 2 business days. Delivery then takes 3-7 business days in the US (UPS 2-5). Express options are shown at checkout.
Yes: we ship to the US, Canada, the UK and the EU. International orders take 7-14 business days and duties are included at checkout.
You can return unused items within 30 days of delivery (60 days if damaged or wrong). Start a return right here with /return. Clearance and gift cards are final sale.
Shipping is free on orders over $75 in the US. Below that, standard shipping is $5.95.
If your order hasn't shipped yet, tap Talk to a person and we'll update the address. Once it has shipped, use the carrier link in your tracking to redirect it.

faqs.q: How do I use a discount code?
faqs.a: Enter the code at checkout in the 'Discount code' box. Only one code can be used per order.
